simple.meaning: סְאוֹן (çᵉʼôwn) is a Hebrew action word meaning “perhaps a military boot (as a protection from mud ).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 9:4. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְאוֹן (H5430) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סְאוֹן (çᵉʼôwn) / H5430 is traced through Isaiah 9:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H5430. seon [ סְאוֺן ?] noun [masculine] sandal, boot of soldier (probably loan-word from Assyrian šênu , shoe , sandal (of leather), Dl HWB 634 Wkl Tel Amarna, Glossary, whence (denominative) šênu, put on sandals Dl l.c .; compare Aramaic סֵינָא , , , sandal (verb denominative ); Ethiopic sandal ); — probably construct סֹאֵן כָּלסְֿאוֺן Isa 9:4 every boot of one tramping (absolute Du al).
